[OURAPPROACH](https://www.linkventures.com/about)

01

Backing Boston's Brightest AI Innovators

We invest in top technical founders from MIT, Harvard, and Boston’s ecosystem building impactful AI solutions. Our focus is on scalable models, data-driven products, and disruptive innovation with global potential.

02

Our Investment Framework for AI Startups

From pitch to Series A, we support your AI journey with funding, mentorship, and operational expertise. Our streamlined process is built for speed, clarity, and long-term founder alignment.

03

Building Enduring Value Through Partnership

Beyond funding, we offer 40,000 sqft of incubator space, global networks across six continents, and massive visibility. We build lasting partnerships that fuel long-term AI success.

Fund Overview
